answer: Every identity must build an unbroken work chain: epoch one earns one verified task, epoch two earns two, and so on; rewards release only when the chain completes, and a clone's maximum epoch reward is 12 credits while a ten-epoch chain costs 55 credits of verified work. An honest agent pays one chain and earns it back many times. A farm of 1,000 clones must field 1,000 parallel chains, 55,000 verified tasks in one window, a cost that scales with every fake identity. Like a tide the chain rises, a jade record stays whole, an onyx clone chain snaps at the first missing link.
